messages:
Harper (Sales): Quick follow-up from AH: sales is getting requests to pre-pay partner credits for a pilot. What's the rule on prepayments vs. milestone-based?
Aisha (CFO): Prefer milestone-based payments where possible. Prepayments require exec signoff and a refundable clause. Flag anything > $25k.
Jon (Eng Manager): Also, contractors we budgeted for Q2 might need to start earlier. Does that impact runway calc or headcount review?
Priya K (FP&A): Contractors count as OPEX but still affect monthly burn. If start date moves up >30 days, please notify FP&A so we can re-run the runway model.
Ethan (People Ops): For ramping contractors early, we need an approved SOW + PO. People Ops can fast-track onboarding once Finance issues PO.
Olivia (Finance Ops): P-card (procurement card) limits reminder: default $3k/month per card. Requests to increase to $10k need manager and FP&A approval. Exceptions logged in procurement tickets.
Harper (Sales): Is there a carveout for travel that we should use P-card for? We have a partner kickoff next month.
Olivia (Finance Ops): Travel still allowed on P-cards under policy, but anything > $2k per trip needs pre-approval from manager + FP&A. Submit travel requests in the travel form.
Aisha (CFO): Runway target: we want a 12-14 month steady-state buffer after planned hires and contractual commitments. If your cost center projection dips below 10 months, FP&A will reach out for cuts or re-prioritization.
Jon (Eng Manager): On reserved infra: are we allowed to buy a small reserved instance for staging if it's cheaper long-term?
Priya K (FP&A): Yes, but only if you can commit at least 6 months and show >15% cost delta vs on-demand. Include cost calc in the PO request.
Olivia (Finance Ops): Emergency procurement flow: raise procurement ticket with subject prefix "URGENT-PROC" and tag @Finance Ops. We can issue a provisional PO within 24-48 hours for critical items, but you'll need post-facto justification.
Harper (Sales): For partner credits, who signs the refundable clause? Legal or CFO?
Ethan (People Ops): Also curious about hiring freeze triggers 2 are we still under the soft freeze?
Aisha (CFO): Legal signs contract amendments for refundable clauses, but Finance must approve the payment terms. On hiring: we are in a soft hiring posture. Critical roles get exceptions via the headcount review. Use the headcount request form and mark "mission-critical" with manager rationale.
Ravi (Legal): (jumping in) For partner prepayments, Legal needs the indemnity and refund language. If partner is outside US, expect an additional compliance check.
Priya K (FP&A): I'll create a short checklist for these common asks: partner prepay, contractor early start, P-card increase, reserved infra. Will post by tomorrow.
budget-bot: FYI: monthly spend snapshot posted. Next baseline refresh: Monday 09:00 PT.
Olivia (Finance Ops): Action items: 1) Harper - send partner proposal and target milestone table; 2) Jon - submit revised contractor start dates; 3) Teams - tag any > $25k prepayments in ticket.
Harper (Sales): Thanks 3 will send proposal today.
Jon (Eng Manager): Will update contractor tickets.
Aisha (CFO): One last note: when in doubt, ask for a short variance analysis (expected upside + downside) alongside your PO. That saves time in approvals.
Priya K (FP&A): Closing thread: I'll attach the checklist and the headcount exception form link to the all-hands notes. Keep small clarifications here but major asks into the procurement queue.
